_meta.description: Ethiopian agroecological soil-fertility lookup bands for zone-aware analysis. Values are in the project's model units (kg/ha for N, P, K over the 0-20 cm plow layer; pH in 1:2.5 water). P follows the bulk-density conversion 1 mg/kg = 2.6 kg/ha (bulk density 1.3 g/cm3, 20 cm depth); lab mg/kg values are kept alongside for traceability.
sources: Debre Zeit Agricultural Research Center (DZARC) / FAO
Werwer Agricultural Research Center / FAO Ethiopia
ILRI Vertisol Management Series and EthioSIS national atlas

highland_nitisols.constraint: Al3+/Mn2+ toxicity and extreme P fixation by Fe/Al oxides
highland_nitisols.source: EIAR / Jimma Agricultural Research Center (JARC); Haramaya University soil chemistry profiling

highland_vertisols.constraint: Low N mineralization and poor aeration via waterlogging/denitrification
highland_vertisols.source: Debre Zeit Agricultural Research Center (DZARC) / FAO; ILRI Vertisol Management Series

rift_valley.constraint: Rapid organic matter depletion and micronutrient locking (Zn/B)
rift_valley.source: Melkassa Agricultural Research Center (MARC); FAO-Ethiopia irrigated land suitability frameworks

arid_semi_arid.constraint: High ECe (salinity), sodicity (ESP > 15%), and osmotic stress
arid_semi_arid.source: Werwer Agricultural Research Center / FAO Ethiopia; Afar/Somali Regional Bureau of Agriculture salinity mapping
